landing.heroSubtitle: Shabbat dinners. Kosher places. An AI rabbi in your pocket. Find your community or discover new ones — in any city in the world.
landing.feature1Body: Candle-lighting times for your location. Shabbat dinners in your community. Home out of the box.
landing.feature2Body: 6 scenarios plus free-form chat. Knows your community and the weekly parashah.
landing.feature3Body: A digital passport with a QR code. Any community worldwide can verify you in seconds.
landing.footer: A platform for Jewish communities around the world

assistant.icalSummary: Subscribe your calendar to tasks and events
assistant.icalDescription: Copy the link and add it as a new calendar in Apple Calendar / Google Calendar / Outlook — your tasks and community events will appear there automatically and stay updated.
assistant.welcomeSubtitle: Tap the microphone and speak, or type. I'll find people in the community, create tasks, set reminders, and send notifications.
